name: MMSLAB 多媒体安全实验室
institution: 武汉大学国家网络安全学院
intro: 围绕多媒体内容的理解、真实性与安全性，以及多媒体信息隐藏与隐写分析，开展方法研究和系统实践。
about: 团队目前开展多媒体安全与信息隐藏两个方向的研究。多媒体安全方向涵盖内容理解、音视频伪造检测、对抗防御与身份保护；信息隐藏方向涵盖压缩域隐写、隐写分析及神经网络信息隐藏。

directions.title: 多媒体安全
directions.subtitle: MULTIMEDIA SECURITY
directions.description: 研究声音与视频内容理解、深度伪造检测、实时交互安全和对抗防御，关注技术在压缩、噪声和真实通信环境下的可靠性。

subareas.title: 语音安全
subareas.description: 围绕语音深度伪造检测、语音编辑定位、声纹保护与溯源开展研究，关注重放、压缩和实时通信对检测可靠性的影响。
subareas.descriptionEn: Studies speech deepfake detection, speech-edit localization, voiceprint protection and speaker tracing, with attention to replay, compression and real-time communication.

subareas.title: 视频安全
subareas.description: 围绕视频及人脸伪造检测、人脸活体检测和身份保护开展研究，并探索音视频联合建模、事件理解与真实视频通话场景下的鲁棒性。
subareas.descriptionEn: Studies video and facial deepfake detection, face liveness and identity protection, alongside audio-visual modeling, event understanding and robustness in real video calls.

directions.title: 信息隐藏
directions.subtitle: INFORMATION HIDING
directions.description: 围绕音视频压缩参数域、隐写分析与神经网络信息隐藏，研究信息嵌入的隐蔽性、鲁棒性和可检测性。

subareas.title: 语音信息隐藏
subareas.description: 研究语音及音频中的隐写与隐写分析，涵盖 AMR 等压缩域中的信息嵌入与检测，以及生成式音频隐写的安全性和抗压缩能力。
subareas.descriptionEn: Studies speech and audio steganography and steganalysis, including embedding and detection in compressed formats such as AMR, and security and compression robustness in generative audio steganography.

subareas.title: 视频信息隐藏
subareas.description: 研究视频压缩域中的信息嵌入与隐写分析，重点关注运动矢量、多域一致性与局部最优性等特征，以及复杂传输条件下的隐蔽性和可检测性。
subareas.descriptionEn: Studies embedding and steganalysis in compressed video, focusing on motion vectors, cross-domain consistency and local optimality, as well as concealment and detectability under transmission distortions.

historicalHiding.summary: AMR steganalysis using correlations between identical pulse positions.

historicalHiding.title: MSDPD
historicalHiding.summary: AMR steganalysis based on second-order pitch-period differences.

historicalHiding.title: PDM-AFS
historicalHiding.summary: Secure AMR steganography based on pulse distributions.

historicalHiding.title: MultiSpecNet
historicalHiding.summary: Universal audio steganalysis using a multiscale spectrogram network.

historicalHiding.title: SPOM / PB-NOP
historicalHiding.summary: Video steganalysis based on optimal probability differences and block-wise local optimality.
